title: Reviewer-contribution declaration — schema companion
description: JSON Schema for a capability's `review-contributions.yaml` (shipped at `.pkit/capabilities/<cap>/review-contributions.yaml`). Per project-management:DEC-032, a capability declares reviewer-contribution rules, each pairing a classification match-predicate with a required reviewer-agent name; pm collects them by walking the manifest-registered capabilities. The matching declaration in `schemas/` documents the format and is paired with this validator.

axisMatch.description: Value(s) a rule matches on for one classification axis. A scalar string matches that one value; the `"*"` wildcard matches EVERY value of the axis (axis-present — forward-safe versus enumerating a fixed value set); a list matches if the closing issue's value is ANY listed one (OR within the axis). A `"*"` inside a list is a literal value, not the wildcard.

contributions.description: List of reviewer-contribution rules. An empty list is valid (a capability that ships the file but contributes nothing).

match.description: Classification match-predicate (DEC-012). Keys are classification axes; `workstream` and `type` are supported (both mutually_exclusive). A rule matches a closing issue when every key/value pair holds for that issue's classification (multi-axis is AND-composed). Optional when a `floor` is present; a rule must declare a `match`, a `floor`, or both.

floor.description: Diff-property floor (DEC-032 amendment): require the reviewer whenever the PR's diff matches the property, independent of classification. `touches-code` fires when the diff touches any non-documentation file — backstopping the classification gate-escape for a code-review reviewer. Optional; a rule must declare a `match`, a `floor`, or both.

reviewer.description: Required reviewer-agent name. Must correspond to a deployed agent file at `.claude/agents/<name>.md` (or wherever the harness deploys agents). Local-path only at v1 (per DEC-032 D2).
